blocks.html: Saying to the Commissioners: here is my brother Martin Guerre; and I confess frankly the error in which this abominable traitor (pointing to the said du Tilh, there present) had by false tokens placed me and my other sisters, nay all the people of Artigat, and long kept us. Whereupon the said newcomer began to weep also. Afterwards the other sisters likewise recognised him, and, to be brief, all the other witnesses who before had so firmly maintained the prisoner to be Martin Guerre.
